cases.sentence: Он сделал эфот из ___, из голубой, пурпурной и алой пряжи, и из крученого льна.
cases.translation: He made the ephod of gold, blue, purple, and scarlet, and of fine twined linen.
cases.explain: The preposition из (of/from) always governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Они сделали для Эфода наплечники по двум углам, чтобы он застегивался к ___.
cases.translation: They made shoulder straps for the ephod at both corners to fasten to it.
cases.explain: The preposition к (to) always governs the dative case.

cases.sentence: Вставили ониксы в золотые филигранные оправы, вырезали на них имена сыновей ___.
cases.translation: They set onyx stones in gold filigree settings and engraved the names of the sons of Israel.
cases.explain: The possessive construction 'sons of' uses the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Они сделали для нагрудника цепочки из чистого ___.
cases.translation: They made chains for the breastplate of pure gold.
cases.explain: The preposition из (of/made of) always governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Кольца нагрудника связали с кольцами эфода голубым ___.
cases.translation: The rings of the breastplate were connected to the rings of the ephod with a blue cord.
cases.explain: The preposition с (with) takes the instrumental case to show the means of connection.

cases.sentence: Все одеяние под эфот было голубым, тканным, с вырезом в ___.
cases.translation: The robe of the ephod was all of blue, woven, with an opening in a row.
cases.explain: The preposition в (in) with a location always governs the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Нашили гранатовые плоды по нижнему краю ___.
cases.translation: They sewed pomegranates around the hem of the garment.
cases.explain: After 'edge' (край), the genitive case shows what the edge belongs to.

cases.sentence: Из чистого золота сделали пластинку, священный ___.
cases.translation: They made the plate of the holy crown of pure gold.
cases.explain: Венец is in apposition to пластинку, serving as a nominative predicate adjective.

reading.ru: Из голубой, пурпурной и алой пряжи они сделали тканное одеяние для служения в святилище и священное одеяние для Аарона, как повелел Моисею Господь.
reading.question: What materials were used to make the sacred garment for Aaron?
reading.explain: The text explicitly states they made the garment from blue, purple, and scarlet yarn.

reading.ru: Они сделали для Эфода наплечники по двум углам, чтобы он застегивался.
reading.question: What was the purpose of the shoulder straps on the ephod?
options: To fasten the ephod at both corners
reading.correct: To fasten the ephod at both corners
reading.explain: The text states the shoulder straps were made at both ends so the ephod could be fastened.

reading.ru: Вставили ониксы в золотые филигранные оправы и вырезали на них, как на печати имена сыновей Израиля.
reading.question: What was engraved on the onyx stones in gold settings?
options: The names of the sons of Israel
The names of all the tribes
reading.correct: The names of the sons of Israel
reading.explain: The text describes engraving on the stones like on a seal the names of the sons of Israel.

reading.ru: Он был квадратным, когда сложен вдвое, пять в длину и пять в ширину, из сложенной вдвое ткани.
reading.question: What were the dimensions of the breastplate when folded?
options: Five by five cubits made of doubled fabric
reading.correct: Five by five cubits made of doubled fabric
reading.explain: The text states the breastplate was square when folded double, five by five spans.

reading.ru: Они сделали для нагрудника цепочки из чистого золота, свитые подобно веревке.
reading.question: What were the chains for the breastplate made of?
options: Pure gold braided like a cord
reading.correct: Pure gold braided like a cord
reading.explain: The text describes chains made of pure gold twisted or braided like a rope.

reading.ru: Так была завершена работа над Скинией, шатром собрания.
reading.question: What was completed according to this statement?
options: All the work on the Tabernacle, the Tent of Meeting
reading.correct: All the work on the Tabernacle, the Tent of Meeting
reading.explain: The verse states that all the work on the Tabernacle, the Tent of Meeting was completed.
